verdict.rationale: DeepInfra documents a model catalog on shared, pay-per-token serverless endpoints with no idle GPU cost. The catalog covers LLMs, vision, embeddings, image/video and speech models, and DeepInfra says it is typically among the first providers to deploy newly released models. A community comment confirms popular models are served on shared infrastructure. However, no evidence names the specific open-weight families the story asks about. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek and GPT-OSS models are in the serverless catalog; a published model list showing catalog breadth and currency; independent hands-on corroboration.
